name: UserSpecificRestriction
summary: The card component of User Specific Restriction (DUO_0000026). The requester's platform account belongs to an approved user, is of an allowed account type, or has a profile status the owner accepts. Outputs a DataUseConditionCredential about the requester.

approvedUsers.description: Route 1: approved user identifiers, matched against UserPlatformCredential claims.userId.

allowedAccountTypes.description: Route 2: allowed account types, matched against claims.accountType.

requiredProfileStatuses.description: Route 3: accepted profile statuses, matched against claims.profileStatus. An alternative route, not an extra requirement.
